mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 63 degrees with overcast skies near the Verona Public Library, and we have a moderate air quality alert of 55, under the light of a waxing gibbous moon.

The City Clerk is hosting an I Voted sticker contest for K-12 students to design the stickers for our November election, with community voting scheduled to run from July 28 through August 7, and the Public Works Department reminds everyone to check their mailboxes to ensure they meet specifications before the snowplow season begins.

There is plenty to do today including the Dane County Farmers Market, as well as live music at Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by yoga at Insight Wellness on July 27.
On July 13, the Verona Police Department responded to a call where they arrested a 36-year-old Madison man for his first O-W-I after his vehicle became immobilized on a large rock.

Today is a great day to enjoy the Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough flavor; since the store is currently closed, plan your visit for when they open at 10 AM, and remember that tomorrow we will have OREO Cookie Overload.
